content.short: KelVPN provides deanonymization protection so users stay anonymous.
content.description: KelVPN is a cross-platform decentralized VPN that brings Web2 premium features into a Web3 network security model. It operates across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polkadot, Multichain, and Polygon, enabling users to run KelVPN nodes and contribute bandwidth and stability to the private network. By running a node, users earn the $KEL token, whose primary utility is to incentivize node runners, while traders can profit from its tokenomics on decentralized exchanges.
